notes: 'I sware' is read as an indivisible rendering of the nāśāʾ-yāḏ idiom (the packet's own gloss note names it), with the object marker left unrepresented under rule 16's default.
אֲשֶׁר takes the 'for' the ASV writes at the head of the recast clause, a present morpheme taking its English before a supplied reading does; the competing added reading is named on that unit.
